QUOTE: `createPost` in the client (`app/client/rest/posts.ts:43`) sends `noRetry: true`. `buildRequestOptions` (`app/client/rest/tracking.ts:378`) turns that into `retryPolicyConfiguration = {retryLimit: 0}`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says posting opts out of retries, but it never states that requests in general retry with exponential backoff, limit 3, set by the network manager.
